evidence: descriptor/project_selection/features.rs:7-12 creates ProjectPluginFeatureSelection::new without target modes; project_plugin_feature_selection.rs:66-77 initializes target_modes empty and :112-114 treats empty as all targets. A feature module restricted to ClientRuntime therefore yields true for raw descriptor.project_selection().features[0].supports_target(ServerRuntime). feature_registration_report/project_selection.rs:15-18 separately derives module target modes. RuntimePluginRegistrationReport::from_plugin stores the raw projection at registration_report/plugin.rs:58; runtime_plugin_catalog/feature_completion/owner_selection.rs later fills it for completed catalog manifests. Related type/target predicate contract remains at zircon_runtime/src/core/framework/project/project_plugin_manifest/project_plugin_feature_selection.rs; source TODO label is located in descriptor/project_selection/features.rs, not the related type file.
impact_or_question: The raw public descriptor projection leaves optional feature target_modes empty, while the feature registration projection derives them and catalog completion later fills missing target modes. Determine whether requiring completion before direct consumption is an intentional API precondition or projection drift.
next_action: Document the completion precondition if intended, or align descriptor projection with feature registration derivation after a direct-versus-completed ClientRuntime-only feature contract test.
